decision.reasoning_trace: I was primarily looking for a high-capacity internal frame backpack for hiking, specifically evaluating the Mardingtop 70L (prod_backpacks_137). However, multiple reviews regarding poor build quality and issues with the refund process are highly discouraging. I also considered the G4Free tactical backpack (prod_backpacks_050) as a secondary option, but a review indicating it failed after only six months of use suggests it might not be durable enough for long-term outdoor activities. The hydration pack (prod_backpacks_132) and various sling bags evaluated are well-rated but do not meet my current requirement for a primary large-capacity pack. Given the quality concerns on the larger backpacks in this feed, I have decided not to make a purchase.
